{"consolidated_memory":"CONFLICT LOOP IN mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift — THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS

All three incidents involved the same symptom and repro but had different root causes and fixes, all in the mobile sync side of mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift.

**Common across all three:**
- Component: mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift
- Problem: conflict loop in sync engine
- Signal: two clients rewriting each other on every pass
- Repro: edit the same note on two devices offline
- Stack: Swift; covering tests in mobile/ios/SyncEngineTests.swift

---

**INCIDENT 1: [2026-07-01]**
- Trigger: sessions that arrived through OAuth provider
- Root cause: race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with double-checked lock
- PR #6452, branch fix/conflict-loop-2
- Outcome: cold start dropped 27 percent, to 781 ms

**INCIDENT 2: [2026-07-17]**
- Trigger: first request after cold start
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #6853, branch fix/conflict-loop-3
- Outcome: throughput rose 42 percent, to 875 requests per second

**INCIDENT 3: [2026-08-13]**
- Trigger: clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of digest
- PR #8768, branch fix/conflict-loop-4
- Outcome: 24 duplicate rows a day stopped being written"}
